name: Web UI page title includes project folder
description:
Distinguish multiple planner web UI instances (e.g. heca in two different project directories) by including the project folder name in the browser tab title.

Current state: `packages/plan-web-ui/src/app/root.tsx` always sets `document.title` to `Project Name · Agent Plan`, which makes it impossible to tell apart two projects with the same name opened in different directories (e.g. `~/projects/myvim` and `~/projects/heca` both named "Heca").

Goal: append the basename of the project root directory to the page title when it differs from the project name, producing titles such as `Heca · myvim` vs `Heca · heca`.

Out of scope: multi-planner server/UI, favicon differentiation, URL-based switching.

Implementation:
- Read `project.projectRoot` from the root loader (already exposed by `@agent-plan/server`).
- Compute the folder name from the last segment of `project.projectRoot`.
- Update the `useEffect` in `RootRoute` to set `document.title = project.name` plus the folder suffix.
- Keep the fallback title `Agent Plan` when the project name is missing.

Acceptance criteria:
- For `/Users/antonio/projects/myvim`: tab title is `Heca · myvim`.
- For `/Users/antonio/projects/heca`: tab title is `Heca · heca`.
- For `/Users/antonio/projects/agent-plan`: tab title is `Agent Plan · agent-plan`.
- Build and type-check pass.
